title: Concept: Maven repository declared over cleartext
description: pom.xml declares a repository URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Artifacts and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can replace both the jar and the checksum file.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: Artifacts and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can replace both the jar and the checksum file.
